terms.comment: Classically situs is the lie of a place, its site (see position); the internet is interrēte, from rēte, a net (Traupman 261).

sources: Lewis & Short: situs
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 261–262, 405, checked against the searchable text of the book (9 November 2026).
